headline_marked: Efforts underway to [[bring Sheikh Hasina back to face trial]], says Shama Obaed
headline: Efforts underway to bring Sheikh Hasina back to face trial, says Shama Obaed
summary: State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaed confirms that work is being done to extradite the former prime minister to Bangladesh.
details: State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaed Islam stated that the people of Bangladesh want former prime minister Sheikh Hasina to be extradited and face trial in the country.
The minister confirmed that efforts are currently underway to bring her back to Bangladesh to complete the legal proceedings.
When asked about recent remarks, the state minister noted that there is nothing new to disclose at this moment regarding the specific progress of these efforts.

India's Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated on April 17 that India is examining the request for Hasina's extradition as part of ongoing judicial and internal legal processes.
Bangladesh had reiterated its request to extradite both Sheikh Hasina and former home minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal, who have been awarded the death penalty by the International Crimes Tribunal.
Prime Minister's Foreign Affairs Adviser Humaiun Kobir recently emphasized that the extradition will be sought through a transparent judicial process.
Separately, Shama Obaed also mentioned that Bangladesh aims to maintain good relations with all nations, including China, to safeguard national interests.
caption:
Efforts are underway to bring former PM Sheikh Hasina back to Bangladesh to face trial.

State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaed Islam stated that the people of Bangladesh want former prime minister Sheikh Hasina to be extradited and face trial in the country.

The minister confirmed that efforts are currently underway to bring her back to Bangladesh to complete the legal proceedings.

When asked about recent remarks, the state minister noted that there is nothing new to disclose at this moment regarding the specific progress of these efforts.

India's Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated on April 17 that India is examining the request for Hasina's extradition as part of ongoing judicial and internal legal processes.

Bangladesh had reiterated its request to extradite both Sheikh Hasina and former home minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal, who have been awarded the death penalty by the International Crimes Tribunal.

Prime Minister's Foreign Affairs Adviser Humaiun Kobir recently emphasized that the extradition will be sought through a transparent judicial process.

Separately, Shama Obaed also mentioned that Bangladesh aims to maintain good relations with all nations, including China, to safeguard national interests.

headline_marked: World Cup: [[Senegal leads Belgium 1-0]] at halftime
headline: World Cup: Senegal leads Belgium 1-0 at halftime
summary: Habib Diarra scored the opening goal for Senegal in the Round of 32 clash at Lumen Field in Seattle.
details: Senegal holds a 1-0 lead over Belgium at the end of the first half in their World Cup Round of 32 match. Habib Diarra found the back of the net to give the African side the advantage.
The match took place at Lumen Field in Seattle, kicking off at 2 AM Bangladesh time on Wednesday.
Senegal dominated the early stages of the game with stronger attacks and ball possession. An early attempt by Ismaïla Sarr was saved by Belgian goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois.
The breakthrough came in the 25th minute following a brilliant curved cross from Sadio Mané. Ismaïla Sarr's header hit the post, but Habib Diarra capitalized on the rebound to score.
Statistically, Senegal controlled 54% of the ball possession in the first half. Belgium committed 5 times while Senegal committed 4 fouls.
The first half saw Senegal with 1 offside and 2 corners for Belgium compared to 1 for Senegal.
caption:
Senegal takes the lead! Habib Diarra strikes first to put Senegal ahead 1-0 against Belgium at the break.

Senegal holds a 1-0 lead over Belgium at the end of the first half in their World Cup Round of 32 match. Habib Diarra found the back of the net to give the African side the advantage.

The match took place at Lumen Field in Seattle, kicking off at 2 AM Bangladesh time on Wednesday.

Senegal dominated the early stages of the game with stronger attacks and ball possession. An early attempt by Ismaïla Sarr was saved by Belgian goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois.

The breakthrough came in the 25th minute following a brilliant curved cross from Sadio Mané. Ismaïla Sarr's header hit the post, but Habib Diarra capitalized on the rebound to score.

Statistically, Senegal controlled 54% of the ball possession in the first half. Belgium committed 5 times while Senegal committed 4 fouls.

The first half saw Senegal with 1 offside and 2 corners for Belgium compared to 1 for Senegal.
